rubrics.justification: The response overstates what is visible, calling the image a high-magnification ICM view with dense tightly packed cells and implying TE cohesion and zona thinning that are not clearly assessable from this image alone. It relies heavily on the provided 3AA label rather than the actual visible morphology.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, endometrial thickness, prior cycle history, and sperm parameters with embryo quality reasonably well, though sperm quality is described somewhat too favorably despite low concentration.

The structure is logical overall, but there are notable overclaims such as very high euploidy likelihood and >90% euploidy at age 30, plus the implantation estimate may be somewhat inflated for an untested embryo.

General recommendations are mostly conventional, but suggesting diagnostic laparoscopy after a single failed transfer and implying routine progesterone concerns in endometriosis are not strongly guideline-based; PGT-A framing is somewhat simplistic.

Provides clear next-step recommendations on proceeding with transfer, alcohol cessation, luteal support, and future-cycle considerations, though some suggestions are more assertive than evidence warrants.
